rules.statement: The court held that the oral agreement and non-notarial document did not constitute a condition precedent under section 92 of the Evidence Ordinance, as no such condition was proved in this case.
rules.supporting_quote: "I do not think that P3 and the oral agreement referred to by the second plaintiff constitute a condition precedent �to the granting of P2 within the meaning of those words in proviso (3) to section 92 of the Evidence Ordinance"
